page.overview:
Who is Jeremiah?

Jeremiah is the protagonist of Prankster, the first story in Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Not much is known about Jeremiah's physical appearance besides the fact that he wears business-casual khakis and button-down polo shirts to work. On his birthday, he puts on a jacket.
